truths: Real-file verification regenerates actual CLI outputs and fixed fixtures rather than previews or copied HTML.
Chromium1280x900 and320x900, DPR1/100% zoom, fresh contexts measure every required case; browser/version/fonts/OS are saved.
Raw element, full-text Range, every character Range including empty rectangles, UTF-16/codepoint positions and every ancestor overflow/box are retained without coordinate correction.
Acceptance uses horizontal viewport/column fit, real clipping edges, adjacent-cell/row/meta-table nonoverlap and all-image readability; strict own-element vertical containment is not required.
The long fixture has12 ranks, counts123 through2 and total200; w*256 and basename n*176 both measurably wrap at both widths, preserving actual spaces/LF/TAB.
A failed external request or attempted document/popup navigation is recorded and fails just like successful communication; blocking traffic alone cannot establish safety.
Network observation starts before document opening, keeps initial local file load, and continues through actual image review/finalization in the later live-review mode.
No empty case loop, missing measurement, missing browser or ambiguous communication attribution can become an acceptance pass.
